articles.title: Two major airlines cut flights and hike fares as fuel prices surge
articles.summary: Airlines have reduced services and lifted ticket costs as the Iran war weighs on jet fuel costs.

articles.title: Iran, Hezbollah launch missiles at Israel as second Passover eve begins; IDF warns of widening escalation
articles.summary: Ballistic missiles target central and northern Israel as holiday begins; no injuries reported; IDF warns vessels off Lebanon coast to move north amid Hezbollah activity; military says campaign against Iran nearing 'strategic crossroads'
